s: We look back at the words from the last three days.
No new words today, just good practice.
My aunt lives in another city.
My aunt is my mother's sister.
I love my aunt very much.
Birth is the time when a baby comes out.
My sister gave birth to a baby boy.
His birth was a happy day.
A birth is a big day for a family.
The baby's birth brings joy to the whole family.
Every baby has to be born somewhere.
A baby will be born in a hospital.
When a baby is going to be born, the family waits and hopes.
I was born in a small town.
My brother was born in the same town.
We were both born there, and our aunt was born there too.
A birthday comes one year after a birth.
On my birthday, my aunt gives me a cake.
Before we go on, here is a quick word about our app.
The Muse English app gives you new words every day with photos and clear pronunciation, so you can hear each word and say it right.
It has this podcast, fun shadowing stories, quick quizzes, simple grammar lessons, and a leaderboard where you earn points as you learn.
It is free, so install the Muse English app today and keep learning with us!
A ball game is a sport played with a ball.
Baseball is a popular ball game in America.
I love a good ball game on a sunny day.
Baseball is a game played with a bat and ball.
My brother loves to play baseball.
We watch baseball, and we cheer for our team.
Another ball game is American football.
American football is a team sport played with an oval ball.
Many people watch American football on Sundays.
Badminton is a sport played with rackets and a small shuttlecock.
We play badminton in the park on Sundays.
I play badminton with my aunt.
She loves badminton, and I love badminton too.
Basketball is also a ball game.
Basketball is fast, and the ball goes up and down.
I like basketball, but badminton is my favorite.
A cooker is a piece of kitchen equipment for cooking food.
We bought a new electric cooker.
What do you cook on your cooker?
I cook soup on my cooker.
My cooker is clean, and my kitchen is clean too.
After I cook, I clean the cooker, and it is clean again.
A drink is a liquid you can swallow.
Coffee is a dark brown drink made from roasted beans.
I drink coffee, and then I feel ready for the day.
Fast food is food prepared and served quickly.
But home food on my new cooker is best.

My aunt, a birth, to be born, a ball game, baseball, American football, badminton, a cooker, a drink, and coffee.
